verdict.rationale: Flagsmith Experimentation collects events from your application into a managed data warehouse and analyses results with a built-in Bayesian engine, so metrics built from ingested events are plausibly covered. However, the warehouse is Flagsmith-managed rather than the customer's own, and no evidence shows how metrics are defined. Missing for 10: documented metric-definition workflow, ability to define metrics on your own warehouse tables (warehouse-native), transparency into metric computation, independent corroboration.
